Site: 11 Alder Close, Eastmere
Dwelling: detached, 4 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey side extension
The beech at the rear will be 7.5 m from the new wall, outside its root protection area.

T3 beech, mature, protected by Tree Preservation Order 22/2018.
Stem diameter 350 mm; root protection area radius 4.2 m.
The proposed wall at 7.5 m lies outside the root protection area of T3.
